ga.text: General and Administrative Expenses . The Cooperative’s general and administrative expenses include salaries and benefits, professional fees and fees paid to its Board of Directors. The general and administrative expenses for the three-month period ended March 31, 2025 was $258,000, compared to $215,000 during the same respective period in 2024. The increase in general and administrative expenses is due to increased legal, consulting, and accounting expenses in 2025 compared to 2024.

nonop.text: Other Income . Interest income for the three-month period ended March 31, 2025 was $82,000 compared to $109,000 during the same period in 2024. The decrease in other income relates to decreased interest rate yields on the Cooperative’s investments.

wc.text: The Cooperative’s working capital at March 31, 2025 was $6,855,000 compared to $5,681,000 at March 31, 2024. The increased working capital at the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2025 as compared to the end of the first quarter of 2024 is primarily related to maturities of corporate bonds. The Cooperative received cash distributions from ProGold LLC totaling $1,994,000 for the three-month period ended March 31, 2025 compared to $1,990,000 for the three-month period ended March 31, 2024.

ga.text: General and Administrative Expenses . The Cooperative’s general and administrative expenses include salaries and benefits, professional fees and fees paid to its Board of Directors. The general and administrative expenses for the three and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2025 were $139,000 and $535,000, respectively, compared to $123,000 and $483,000 during the same respective periods in 2024. The increase in administrative expenses for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2025 compared to the nine-month period ended September 30, 2024 is primarily due to increased legal and consulting expenses in 2025 compared to 2024 in connection with preparing for member approval of the Plan of Liquidation and Dissolution of the Cooperative, filing of the Notice of Intent to Dissolve and preparing for the sale of the Cooperative’s 50% interest in ProGold to Cargill following expiration of the Facility Lease pursuant to the terms of the Operating Agreement.

nonop.text: Other Income . Interest and investment income (loss) for the three and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2025 was $67,000 and $233,000, respectively, compared to $126,000 and $343,000 during the same respective periods in 2024. The decrease is primarily due to reduced investment income on corporate bonds.

intro.text: Golden Growers Cooperative (“we,” “us,” “our,” and the “Cooperative”) is a value-added agricultural cooperative association owned by 1,445 members primarily from Minnesota, North Dakota and South Dakota, all of whom deliver corn to the Cooperative for processing. The Cooperative was originally formed in 1994 as a North Dakota agricultural cooperative with the goal of allowing its members to receive additional value from the corn that they grow through the processing of that corn into value-added products, such as corn sweeteners.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
